tasks.title: Ledger transfer
tasks.description: Ledger.transfer(from, to, cents) moves cents between two open accounts. The amount follows the deposit rule (a positive integer of cents, else RangeError); an unknown account throws like balance does. When the source holds less than the amount it throws InsufficientFunds (a new Error subclass in src/errors.mjs with name "InsufficientFunds" and fields account, needed, available) and no balance changes.
scenarios: Given a holds 500 and b holds 0 When 200 is transferred from a to b Then a holds 300 and b holds 200
Given a holds 100 When 150 is transferred from a to b Then it throws InsufficientFunds with account "a", needed 150, available 100 and both balances are unchanged
Given amount 0 or 1.5 When transfer is called Then it throws a RangeError and nothing changes
Given an unknown account When transfer is called Then it throws and nothing changes
